label_contract.accident: The still image itself visibly shows a road crash, collision, rollover, or clearly accident-damaged road-vehicle context.
label_contract.non_accident: The still image is a genuine road or traffic scene with no visible accident evidence.

accident_detection_9k.publisher_annotation_requirement: At least one valid YOLO class-0 Accident bounding box.
accident_detection_9k.source_group_basis: Filename before the Roboflow .rf. augmentation identifier; exact and near-duplicate relationships may merge groups further.

dats_2022.sequence_grouping_rule: Use recoverable capture-date/timestamp families conservatively, merge exact and near-duplicate components, and leave unresolved families unsplit until reviewed.

duplicate_policy.exact_identity: SHA-256 over complete source image bytes
